items.title: Define one fail-closed canonical verification-intent reference resolver
items.context: Create one side-effect-free resolver that maps authored stable IDs and valid CHK-item:lane:index tokens to the same immutable checklist row. It must reject malformed lanes, out-of-range indices, wrong checklist ownership, duplicate authored IDs, stable IDs that collide with another row's positional alias, and any other ambiguous mapping.
items.userSees: The exact terminal line "ProofStory REVIEW completeness: pass" appears only when both ref spellings resolve to the same unique authored verificationIntent row; ambiguity reports a fail-closed diagnostic.
excludes: Guessing through duplicate or positional-looking authored IDs

items.title: Use canonical row identity in ProofStory REVIEW completeness and acceptance coverage
items.context: Route the canonical row identity through the complete consumer set: ProofStory REVIEW and DONE completeness, acceptance topology, acceptance coverage-basis, and milestone-status. Update process-fact level/registry/verifier projection so future consumers cannot silently return to raw-string comparison. Evidence pinning, freshness/mechanical rules, and PLAN-only proofstory_contract_set policy remain unchanged.
items.userSees: B-8de3's 13 positional contract refs and 13 authored-ID mechanical receipts are recognized as the same 13 rows without changing contract or evidence bytes.
excludes: Weakening stale, failing, waived, or non-mechanical evidence rules

items.title: Prove B-8de3 mixed-reference compatibility and fail-closed negative controls
items.context: Reproduce the B-8de3 mixed-reference false negative and prove it becomes PASS. Negative controls must cover wrong item/lane/index, malformed/unknown refs, duplicate authored IDs, a stable ID colliding with another positional alias, wrong-checklist-owner evidence, stale/failing/non-mechanical receipts, and REVIEW-phase proofstory_contract_set refusal with byte/hash invariance. Mutation controls must fail when canonicalization or ambiguity checks are removed.
items.userSees: The focused regression prints the exact line "proofstory intent ref equivalence: PASS" only after the mixed-reference positive case and every fail-closed control bite.
